description: Polls the network for up to timeoutSeconds (default 45 to fit hosts with a 60 s tool timeout, max 600). Returns payment confirmations, whether the spec was accepted, and the running instances with URLs. Safe to call repeatedly until done=true.

previousHash.description: For updates: the hash of the previous spec, so acceptance means a new hash.

txid.description: Payment txid from flux_deploy_app, to report confirmations.

name: flux_wait_for_app
title: Wait for a deployment to be accepted and its instances to run
